e.title: Flood Prediction (Databricks)
e.summary: Databricks 官方洪水预测方案加速器：保险巨灾风险（洪水）预测
e.body: Flood Prediction 是 Databricks 官方方案加速器（Unity Catalog + Serverless）：洪水预测——保险巨灾风险（cat risk）的现代工程范式（数据处理+ML 预测+治理）。对 RIAA：洪水/巨灾预测的官方工程参考。与 [[databricks-smart-claims]]（理赔）、[[catia]]（巨灾 AI 平台）、[[spatialextremes]]（空间极值）互补。关联 [[eltr]]（巨灾 ELT）、[[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：Databricks 官方 Flood Prediction Solution Accelerator（Unity Catalog+Serverless）
e.summary_en: Official Databricks flood-prediction solution accelerator: modern engineering pattern for insurance catastrophe (flood) risk
e.summary_hk: Databricks 官方洪水預測方案加速器：保險巨災風險（洪水）預測
e.body_en: Flood Prediction is an official Databricks solution accelerator (Unity Catalog + Serverless): flood prediction — the modern engineering pattern for insurance catastrophe (flood) risk (data processing + ML prediction + governance). For RIAA: the official engineering reference for flood/catastrophe prediction. Complements [[databricks-smart-claims]] (claims), [[catia]] (catastrophe-AI platform) and [[spatialextremes]] (spatial extremes). Related: [[eltr]] (cat ELT), [[reinsurance]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: Flood Prediction 是 Databricks 官方方案加速器（Unity Catalog + Serverless）：洪水預測——保險巨災風險（cat risk）的現代工程範式（數據處理+ML 預測+治理）。對 RIAA：洪水/巨災預測的官方工程參考。與 [[databricks-smart-claims]]（理賠）、[[catia]]（巨災 AI 平台）、[[spatialextremes]]（空間極值）互補。關聯 [[eltr]]（巨災 ELT）、[[reinsurance]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
